commits_data.title: Falco Events: Only show "Follow → Falco FD Stream" when we have data
commits_data.message:
Falco Events: Only show "Follow → Falco FD Stream" when we have data

Add a minimal dissector for the top-level evt and fd protocols so that
they can be added to pinfo->layers, and in turn allow fd to show up in
the "Follow" menu when appropriate.

Register our follow stream handler with the "fd" protocol instead of
"falcoevents".
